findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 列出競爭類別含傳統券商/fintech、加密原生、機構點狀方案、DEX、非USDC穩定幣；因新增股票與預測市場，競爭集合擴大，並預期美國監管明朗後來自美國公司的競爭增加。
findings.excerpt: With the expansion in our product offerings in 2025 to include stocks, prediction markets and more, our competitive set in this category has broadened

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：DEX 交易量多次媲美自家平台，預期競爭加劇。
findings.excerpt: We have seen increased interest in certain decentralized platforms with transaction volumes rivaling our own platform on multiple occasions, and expect interest in decentralized and noncustodial platforms to grow further as the industry develops.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋結果多為二手/低品質來源（含Binance Q2 2026份額升至35.34%、Kalshi進入永續合約、Coinbase美國份額約66%），無可逐字引用原文，僅列線索；份額方向各來源口徑不一。

clues.claim: TokenInsight資料：Binance Q2 2026總市佔由32.77%升至35.34%，為最大增幅。
Bernstein估計Coinbase掌握美國市場66%；Morgan Stanley稱Robinhood可能搶份額。
